description: This file defines the EmployeeLicense entity class for the OrangeHRM system, including properties for license details and ORM mappings.

classes.name: EmployeeLicense
classes.description: Entity class representing an employee's license, with ORM mappings and properties for license details.

methods.name: getLicense
methods.description: Returns the License object associated with this employee license.

methods.name: setLicense
methods.description: Sets the License object for this employee license.

methods.name: getLicenseIssuedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the license was issued.

methods.name: setLicenseIssuedDate
methods.description: Sets the issue date of the license.

methods.name: getLicenseExpiryDate
methods.description: Returns the expiry date of the license.

methods.name: setLicenseExpiryDate
methods.description: Sets the expiry date of the license.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee object associated with this license.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated with this license.
